title.narrative: SO3: Enhanced EPR capabilities in Western Balkans countries.

description.narrative: Specific Objective related to Task 4, Task 5, Task 6, and Task 9; it targets the development and enhancement of capabilities in each Western Balkans country in using JRODOS DSS and in relation to responding to a nuclear or radiological emergency, through: i) participation in tabletop exercises with JRODOS DSS; ii) development of a concept of operation and operational procedures for JRODOS DSS use; iii) development of a sustainable training programme for long term use, and the training of EndUsers in its delivery; iv) provision of support to the Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority of Kosovo to develop the draft version of the National Nuclear and Radiological Emergency Response Plan (NREP) and enhance in this way the preparedness and response framework in Kosovo (as per Addendum 2 to the Service Contract INSC/2019/409169, signed on 15/12/2021).
